text:
maria_customer: Hi team — our AP says the contract promo credits tied to PO PO-99321 (note: 'REDWOOD-Q1-BONUS') never got applied. We're being billed on INV-2026-03 for full usage. Can someone take a look? acct id: 98321.

alyssa_csm: Sorry about that, Maria. Can you paste the PO note or attach the PDF? Looping in @sam_sales and finance.

maria_customer: PO note text copied from PDF: 'REDWOOD-Q1-BONUS — apply as one-time $12,000 credit against next invoice. Reference: PO-99321.' PDF attached to thread.

sam_sales: Looking. Quick check — was this marked as a contract-level promo in the sale, or was it only written on the PO note? If contract-level, should have been auto-applied. If only on the PO, sometimes ingestion misses it.

jeff_finance: I pulled acct 98321 and I don't see an auto-promo entry. No promo_code recorded for PO-99321 in the promotions pipeline. Please forward the PDF to finance inbox if you haven't.

alyssa_csm: Uploading the PO now (po-99321.pdf). Also adding the contract excerpt we have.

billing_bot: Promo ingestion check: failed. reason=PRM-MISSING-FIELD (no promo_code detected). ingestion_id=ing-202603-445.

sam_sales: Thanks @billing_bot. Okay — we'll do a manual sales-issued credit to unblock invoice dispute. @jeff_finance, GL/ledger code? Also want the manual entry to reference PO-99321 so AP can reconcile.

jeff_finance: Use GL 4001-CRED. I'll require the PDF attached and sales note on the journal entry. Once you run the manual grant I'll post the journal.

sam_sales: Running manual grant now:
```
/grant-credit --acct 98321 --amount 12000 --currency USD --reason "Sales manual grant per PO-99321 REDWOOD-Q1-BONUS" --reference PO-99321
```

billing_bot: Manual credit queued. job_id=mc-202603-7721, expected_post=t+1 business day, ledger_ref_pending.

jeff_finance: Preparing journal entry. Will post once the queued job completes. Please ensure sales attaches the PO PDF to the entry for audit trail.

alyssa_csm: Manual credit submitted and PO attached to the case. Maria — we should see the $12,000 credit applied to your account on the next invoice or as an adjustment showing up in billing within 24-48 hours.

sam_sales: Confirmed this matches the negotiated promo. I'll file a follow-up with ingestion team to add a parsing rule for 'REDWOOD-Q1-BONUS' and PO pattern PO-\u003cnumber\u003e so this doesn't recur.

maria_customer: Thank you — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please CC me on the journal post so I can clear the dispute on our side.

jeff_finance: Journal posted: JRN-2026-0457. Transaction id: TX-7721. Adjustment of $12,000 applied to acct 98321. AP reflection may take up to 48 hours.

billing_bot: Ledger update: JRN-2026-0457 posted. reconciliation_status=queued -> reconciled within 48h.

alyssa_csm: :white_check_mark: Closing on our side pending Maria confirmation that the credit appears in AP. Maria, let us know and we'll mark resolved.

maria_customer: Saw the adjustment hit account today, AP showed it on invoice REV-2026-03. All good, thanks everyone.

alyssa_csm: Great — resolving. I'll also add an internal note to the customer record to prevent duplicate promo ingestion attempts.

sam_sales: Filed ticket with ingestion team (ING-3729) to add parser for common PO promo phrases.

jeff_finance: Closing journal thread. If any residuals show up ping me and I'll re-open.

alyssa_csm: Thanks team! :pray:
